verdict.rationale: gstack ships a top-level router skill that 'sends any gstack request to the right skill' across planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security and design. Its domain skills are injected into prompt context automatically for future sessions on the same host. Each SKILL.md carries a purpose-specific description, but nothing shows those descriptions are deliberately engineered for automatic agent activation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of description engineering or trigger rules for auto-activation from task context, hands-on or independent corroboration that skills fire unprompted at the right moment.
